interface.longDescription:
Find federal grants for your team from a live listing and download a grant pipeline tracker and grant deadline calendar.

Search federal grant opportunities by keyword, applicant eligibility, agency, category, posted date and closing date. Scan grants for nonprofits, tribal governments, school districts and other applicant types. Match any keyword word or require all words. Shortlists show grant deadlines, agencies, award amounts and eligibility.

Read a pasted batch of opportunity numbers or IDs and keep successful items when another record fails. Download an XLSX pipeline tracker with blank Status and Owner columns for your team, plus an ICS calendar of closing dates with reminders when their dates have not passed. Filter and sort the shown rows in the widget, copy opportunity numbers and request the next page.

Limits: federal opportunities listed on Grants.gov only; excludes private foundation, state and local grants. Award amounts are agency-entered and may be unstated. Close dates omit deadline times and time zones; check the notice. Forecasted dates are estimates. Up to 30 rows per search page and 20 inputs per details call. Broad searches screen the first 1,000 upstream rows. Download links expire in about an hour.
defaultPrompt: Find federal grants for 501(c)(3) nonprofits in education closing in the next 60 days
Show grant opportunities posted this week for tribal governments
Make a grant deadline calendar for 2026-NTIA-TBCP and RFA-DK-26-310

positive.prompt: Find federal grants for nonprofits in education and make a grant pipeline tracker.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a live shortlist with applicant eligibility, a pipeline download, and a source retrieval line; may explain no matches.

positive.prompt: Show grant deadlines and details for 2026-NTIA-TBCP and 999999999.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the found opportunity and a per-item error for the missing record, with available download files.

positive.prompt: Find federal grant opportunities posted this week at HHS for tribal governments.
positive.expected_behavior: Expands the department filter and includes unrestricted notices; returns source retrieval information and any per-item errors.

positive.prompt: Show federal grant opportunities for opportunity ID 359145 and make a grant deadline calendar.
positive.expected_behavior: Looks up the numeric opportunity ID, returns a pipeline tracker, and includes a calendar when the closing date is eligible.

positive.prompt: Find federal grant opportunities for zzqxwvplorkfoo.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports no matches as a normal result without download links.

pl-PL.subtitle: Granty federalne i terminy
pl-PL.description: Wyszukuj federalne dotacje z publicznego rejestru według słów kluczowych, uprawnień i terminów. Pobierz arkusz XLSX i kalendarz ICS. Tylko dotacje federalne w USA; prognozowane daty są szacunkowe. Linki wygasają po około godzinie.

de-DE.subtitle: Fördermittel und Fristen
de-DE.description: Finden Sie US-Bundesförderungen im öffentlichen Verzeichnis nach Stichwort, Antragstyp und Frist. Laden Sie eine XLSX-Übersicht und einen ICS-Kalender herunter. Prognosen sind Schätzungen. Links laufen nach etwa einer Stunde ab.

es-ES.subtitle: Subvenciones y plazos
es-ES.description: Busca subvenciones federales de EE. UU. por palabras clave, elegibilidad y fecha. Descarga un registro XLSX y un calendario ICS. Solo convocatorias federales; las fechas previstas son estimaciones. Los enlaces caducan en aproximadamente una hora.

fr-FR.subtitle: Subventions et échéances
fr-FR.description: Recherchez les subventions fédérales américaines par mots-clés, admissibilité et dates. Téléchargez un suivi XLSX et un calendrier ICS. Les dates prévisionnelles sont estimées. Les liens expirent après environ une heure.

ja-JP.subtitle: 連邦助成金と締め切り
ja-JP.description: 米国連邦助成金の公開情報をキーワード、申請資格、日付で検索します。XLSXの管理表とICSカレンダーをダウンロードできます。予告日程は推定です。リンクは約1時間で期限切れになります。

pt-BR.subtitle: Subsídios federais e prazos
pt-BR.description: Busque oportunidades federais dos EUA por palavra-chave, elegibilidade e data. Baixe um controle XLSX e um calendário ICS. Datas previstas são estimativas. Os links expiram em cerca de uma hora.
